ABGroup.doc: An object that represents a group of records in the Address Book database.

ABPerson.doc: An object that encapsulates all information about a person in the Address Book database.

ABSearchElement.doc: An object you use to specify a search query for records in the Address Book database.

ABImageClient.doc: Methods for responding to a request to load images associated with a contact.

+addPropertiesAndTypes:.doc: Adds the given properties to all records of this type in the Address Book database.

+properties.doc: Returns an array of the names of all the properties for this record type in the Address Book database.

+removeProperties:.doc: Removes the given properties from all the records of this type in the Address Book database.

+searchElementForProperty:label:key:valu.doc: Returns a search element object that searches for records of this type.

+typeOfProperty:.doc: Returns the type for a given property.

-addMember:.doc: Adds a person to a group.

-addSubgroup:.doc: Adds a subgroup to another group.

-distributionIdentifierForProperty:perso.doc: Returns the distribution identifier for the given property and person.

-members.doc: Returns an array of persons in a group.

-parentGroups.doc: Returns an array containing a group’s parents—that is, the groups that a group belongs to.

-removeMember:.doc: Removes a person from a group.

-removeSubgroup:.doc: Removes a subgroup from a group.

-setDistributionIdentifier:forProperty:p.doc: Assigns a specific distribution identifier for a person’s multivalue list property so that the group can be used as a distribution list.

-subgroups.doc: Returns an array containing a group’s subgroups.

+addPropertiesAndTypes:.doc: Adds the given properties to all the records of this type in the Address Book database.

+cancelLoadingImageDataForTag:.doc: Cancels an asynchronous fetch of the images for a given tag.

+properties.doc: Returns an array of the names of all the properties for the record in the Address Book database.

+removeProperties:.doc: Removes the given properties from all the records of this type in the Address Book database.

+searchElementForProperty:label:key:valu.doc: Returns a search element object that specifies a query for records of this type.

+typeOfProperty:.doc: Returns the type of a given property.

-beginLoadingImageDataForClient:.doc: Starts an asynchronous fetch for image data in all locations

-imageData.doc: Returns data that contains a picture of this person.

-linkedPeople.doc: Returns the array of all person records that are linked to the person this record represents.

-parentGroups.doc: Returns an array of the address book groups that this person belongs to.

-setImageData:.doc: Sets the image for this person to the given data.

-vCardRepresentation.doc: Returns the vCard representation of the person record as a data object in vCard format.

+searchElementForConjunction:children:.doc: Returns a compound search element, created by combining the search elements in an array with the given conjunction.

-matchesRecord:.doc: Tests whether or not a record matches a search element.

init(VCardRepresentation:).doc: Returns an ABPerson instance initialized with the given data.
